title: The story of Alhambra
text: Our review is centred on the natural beauty of the Alhambra and then the skill with which we were told its magical story by Enrique. I’d recommend this guided tour to anyone wanting the English tour.
author: Oliver_S

title: Great tour!!
text: The Alhambra tour was extremely interesting. Our guide, Barha (probably misspelled, sorry!) was extremely knowledgeable and spoke excellent English. He provided historical information about the people, empires, religious differences and preferences, architecture, water sources and hydrology, botanical information, and basic observations that added so much more than we expected. Great tour and great guide! Highly recommend this for everyone visiting Granada.
author: Seaside27057190650

title: An amazing tour guide that made a memorable experience!
text: Our tour guide, Cristina was amazing!!! She was very knowledgeable and considerate to all my family needs during our tour time. She made the experience memorable and wish to have her again for future tours in Granada.
author: Cesar_S

title: Amazing
text: The truth is that despite the heat and more than 4 hours of touring, it was very enjoyable thanks to José Antonio's guidance, his anecdotes, and telling the history of the Alhambra in an entertaining way. Beautiful experience
author: andreacU3694HN

title: Alhambra beautiful and special place to visit
text: If you are staying in Granada city take a taxi to the Alhambra as it's uphill. The walk back through the tree lined pathway is a lovely stroll. We had a lovely tour guide, Natalia. The tour was very interesting. The Alhambra, it's gardens and views are breathtaking. Don't miss this if you are staying in or near Granada.
author: Angela_H

title: Fab day tour
text: Enrique told us passionately about the Alhambra and its turbulent history! Thank you. We had a lovely air conditioned van. Would recommend booking early to get the Nasrid palace tickets but we still had an amazing tour.
author: Maryannpatricia
